modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
follow the fundamentals of 5S for waste management
segregate waste into different categories
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

modules.module_title: Communicate effectively with colleagues, customers and others

pcs.pc_description: maintain clear communication with colleagues, customers and others, wherever needed, through all means i.e. face-to-face, telephonic or written
adjust communication styles to reflect gender and persons with disability (PwD) sensitivity
work in a way that shows respect for colleagues and others
follow the organisation’s policies and procedures while working in a team
respect personal space of colleagues and customers
identify work requirements by receiving instructions from reporting supervisor
escalate problems to supervisors that cannot be handled including repairs and maintenance of machine
report the completed work
rectify errors as per feedback

modules.module_title: Support assembly operator in pre-assembly activities

pcs.pc_description: identify the tools, measuring instruments, equipment, auto components/ parts and subassemblies required for the job as per SOP and assembly operator's instructions

collect the required tools, measuring instruments, equipment, auto components/ parts and subassemblies from the stores and ensure that all the items required for production and inspection are available as per SOP
check the tools and equipment for any defects and that they are as per the required quality standards
clean the assembling equipment, auto components/ parts and subassemblies of any dust and impurities
support the assembly operator in setting of the equipment required as per the selected assembling method
ensure that there is no damage done to the auto component and subassemblies during loading on the assembling equipment manually or using pulleys, chains and other hoisting mechanisms

modules.module_title: Support the assembly operator in assembly activities

pcs.pc_description: hold the tools during assembly operations in the correct manner as specified by the operator using appropriate PPE
provide appropriate consumables and accessories to operator during welding process

support in installation of the Oil and Lube systems by placing and fitting the funnel, filters, hose pipes, glands, sockets, suction guns and regulator valves as prescribed in the Work Instructions/ SOPs/Control Plans
unload the components from the assembling equipment and put it on right trolley/bin

modules.module_title: Support the assembly operator in post-assembly activities

pcs.pc_description: fill the water, diesel or petrol, brake oil, gear oil, engine oil etc. in the vehicle as per the operator's instructions
support in checking the assembled auto components as per the work instructions for product quality
clean and store the tools, equipment and fixtures by following organisational policies and procedures after completion of work
clean the workarea properly after completion of work
dispose of scrap or waste material in accordance with the company policies and environmental regulations
